senses.gloss:
ITA-9.2.44 avagāhasvedaḥ अवगाहस्वेदः
Sweating induced by immersion in prewarmed liquid
Sudation achieved by immersion: sitting in a prewarmed liquid such as a medicated oil or decoction.

ITA-3.2.4.28 avaṭuḥ, ghāṭā अवटुः, घाता
Nape of the neck

ITA-5.62.37 avapīḍakaḥ अवपीडकः
Preputial tear
A disorder characterized by fissuring or cracking of the preputial skin.

ITA-9.2.91 avapīḍanam अवपीडनम्
Intranasal therapy with expressed juice from paste
Therapeutic intranasal instillation of the freshly expressed juice of herbal drugs.

ITA-9.6.200 avabaddhaśalyam अवबद्धशल्यम्
Firmly lodged foreign body
A foreign body which is strongly impacted or stuck in the body.

ITA-5.2.1.48 avabāhukaḥ अवबाहुकः
Painful conditions of shoulder joints with severely affected or restricted movements
A disorder characterized by atrophy of structures binding the shoulder joints/wasting of shoulder region; ligamentous contractions; inhibition of upper limb movements.

ITA-3.10.1.2 avabhāsinī, udakadharā अवभासिनी, उदकधरा
First layer of skin

ITA-5.58.2 avamanthaḥ अवमन्थः
Multiple large boils on the penis
A disease of the penis characterized by the appearance of large boils; multiple boils; pitted in centre of boil; painful; causing hyperaesthesia/horripilation.

ITA-5.76.24 vamanamithyāyogaḥ/ avamyānām vamana vyāpadaḥ वमनमिथ्यायोगः / अवम्यानाम् वमन व्यापदः
Condition due to improper emetic therapy

ITA-2.1.3.2 avalambaka-kaphaḥ अवलम्बककफः
Supporting kapha
Subtype of kapha seated in the chest region which supports and sustains the heart and other sites of kapha.

ITA-9.6.154 avasādanam अवसादनम्
Hypergranulation reduction
Application of a medicated paste to reduce wound hypergranulation.

ITA-9.9.13 avasādīśukradoṣaḥ अवसादीशुक्रदोषः
Semen with dull flow
An increase in the specific gravity of semen with reduced motility.

ITA-9.6.113 avasecanakarma अवसेचनकर्म
Bloodletting
The process of bloodletting with leeches.

ITA-2.6.4 avasthāpākaḥ अवस्थापाक
Digestion at gastrointestinal tract level

ITA-2.6.32 avasthāpākaḥ अवस्थापाकः
Initial phase of digestion
The initial phase of digestion which involves the action of transformative factors on food in the gastrointestinal tract , which has three sequential stages resulting in the production of kapha, pitta and vata respectively.

ITA-3.16.52 āvartaḥ (marma) आवर्तः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) above the eyebrows
Two in number (one on each side) which when injured leads to blindness or impaired vision.
